Accept the self-hosted runner terms

## Usage

`circleci runner terms <command> [flags]`

## General Commands

| Command  | Description                                             |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `accept` | Accept the self-hosted runner terms for an organization |

## Flags

Global flags: `-c, --config`, `--debug`, `--no-color`, `-q, --quiet` — see `circleci --help`.

## Details

Manage your organization's acceptance of the self-hosted runner terms.

An organization admin must accept the terms once before the organization
can use self-hosted runners.
